title: Addresses from bytes
description:
Print MAC and IPv4 addresses found in raw packet bytes.

```
destination MAC: ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
source MAC:      00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e
EtherType:       0x0800 (IPv4)
source IP:       192.168.1.10
destination IP:  192.168.1.1
```
hints: The IP header starts at byte 14, so the source address is at `frame + 14 + 12` (lesson 4.02).
EtherType 0x0800 is IPv4, 0x86DD IPv6 and 0x0806 ARP.
requirements: The first 14 bytes are the Ethernet header: destination MAC, source MAC, EtherType.
The IPv4 source and destination are at offsets 12 and 16 of the IP header.
stretch: Name the protocol from the IP header's protocol byte (6 TCP, 17 UDP, 1 ICMP).
